tours.name: Confirm a Payslip Batch and Create the Accounting Entries

name_i18n.en_US: Confirm a Payslip Batch and Create the Accounting Entries

tours.description: Learn how to review a payslip batch and confirm all of its payslips in one step, which locks the payslips and creates the draft accounting entries for the salaries.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to review a payslip batch and confirm all of its payslips in one step, which locks the payslips and creates the draft accounting entries for the salaries.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Once every payslip of a pay period has been checked, the whole batch is confirmed in one step from the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Once every payslip of a pay period has been checked, the whole batch is confirmed in one step from the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu gives access to the payslips and to the batches that group them by pay period.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu gives access to the payslips and to the batches that group them by pay period.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: This list shows every batch with its period, its status and the number of payslips it contains. Batches that are not yet done still need to be checked and confirmed.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every batch with its period, its status and the number of payslips it contains. Batches that are not yet done still need to be checked and confirmed.

steps.title: Open the batch
steps.content: Click the batch to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the batch to open it.

steps.description: Open the batch for the period you are closing. Its payslips are listed behind the Payslips button, where you can still review or recompute them.

description_i18n.en_US: Open the batch for the period you are closing. Its payslips are listed behind the Payslips button, where you can still review or recompute them.

steps.title: Create Draft Entry
steps.content: Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the batch.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the batch.

steps.description: This confirms every payslip of the batch at once. The payslips become Done and can no longer be edited, and the draft accounting entries for the salaries are created.

description_i18n.en_US: This confirms every payslip of the batch at once. The payslips become Done and can no longer be edited, and the draft accounting entries for the salaries are created.

steps.title: Confirm in the window
steps.description: Odoo asks for a confirmation because a confirmed payslip is locked. Click Ok to continue.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo asks for a confirmation because a confirmed payslip is locked. Click Ok to continue.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.content: Check that the batch status is now Done, then click the batch name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Check that the batch status is now Done, then click the batch name to finish.

steps.description: The status bar shows the batch as Done. The batch is now closed for changes and ready to be marked as paid.

description_i18n.en_US: The status bar shows the batch as Done. The batch is now closed for changes and ready to be marked as paid.
